resources.name: AWS - CloudTrail - Suspicious Command Execution via SSM Session on Managed Instance
resources.description: This rule triggers when an endpoint detection is observed on an EC2 instance that correlates with AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Session Manager activity, specifically matching process executions with SSM session start events from AWS CloudTrail. It helps identify potential threats like unauthorized access attempts, malicious command execution, or command injection attacks that leverage SSM Session Manager as an attack vector on Falcon-protected EC2 instances.
